name: Remittance Capture Agent
fn: Extracts data from email, PDF, portal & lockbox remittances across all formats and languages
detail: Reads inbound remittances from email bodies, PDF/Excel attachments, lockbox images and EDI files, using a vision LLM + OCR to extract invoice numbers, amounts and dates into a canonical schema. Eliminates manual keying and makes every payment matchable regardless of format or language.
sap: SAP FI-AR (open items, F-28 / F-32 clearing) · FI-BL bank statements (FF67, BAI2 / MT940) · BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST

io.in: Remittances · bank files (BAI2/MT940) · FI-AR open items
